text.It is a very old shrine in Atsuta Ward,: Hili ni hekalu la kale sana la Shinto katika eneo la Atsuta, Nagoya.
text.Kusanagi no Tsurugi, one of Japan's \"Th: Upanga wa Kusanagi, mojawapo ya ‘Hazina Tatu Takatifu’ za Japani, unahifadhiwa hapa.
text.About 7 million people come to pray here: Takriban watu milioni saba huja kusali hapa kila mwaka.
text.There was something that surprised me, e: Kuna jambo lililonishangaza ingawa ninaishi Nagoya.
text.Nagoya is now said to be the 3rd biggest: Sasa inasemekana Nagoya ni jiji la tatu kwa ukubwa nchini Japani,
text.and I wondered, where in Nagoya did it s: nami nikajiuliza, ukuaji wake ulianzia sehemu gani ya Nagoya?
text.When I asked AI, it said the area around: Nilipouliza AI, ilisema eneo linalozunguka Atsuta Jingu hii ni mojawapo ya sehemu ambazo Nagoya ilianza polepole kukua na kuwa jiji.
text.The area around Nagoya Station, which is: Eneo la karibu na Kituo cha Nagoya, ambalo sasa lina shughuli nyingi, ni sehemu mpya iliyokua baada ya enzi ya Meiji.
text.Nagoya Station opened in 1886, so it onl: Kituo cha Nagoya kilifunguliwa mwaka 1886, kwa hiyo kina historia ya takriban miaka 140 tu.
text.As someone from Nagoya, I was a little s: Nikiwa mwenyeji wa Nagoya, nilishangaa kidogo: ‘Kumbe Atsuta Jingu ni mojawapo ya sehemu ambazo Nagoya ilianzia.’
text.Japanese people go to shrines and temple: Karibu na tarehe 1 Januari, Wajapani huenda kusali kwenye madhabahu za Shinto na mahekalu ya Kibudha.
text.Atsuta Jingu is very big inside, but at: Eneo la Atsuta Jingu ni kubwa sana, lakini wakati wa Hatsumode foleni huwa ndefu mno hapa.
text.To say to the gods, \"Please take care o: Ili kuwaambia miungu, ‘Tafadhali nichungeni mwaka huu pia,’ watu wote husubiri kwenye foleni ndefu sana.
text.Atsuta Jingu is a shrine very famous for: Atsuta Jingu pia ni maarufu sana kwa sherehe hii ya Hatsumode.
